name: scaffold_project
description: Write .llm-framework.yml for a new or existing project repository.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project root where .llm-framework.yml will be written.

infrastructure_path.description: Absolute path to the llm-agent-framework infrastructure repo.

team_path.description: Optional: absolute path to a team profile repo.

personal_path.description: Optional: absolute path to a personal profile repo.

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite an existing .llm-framework.yml. Defaults to false.
